name: twitch_connections_login_idx
definition: CREATE INDEX twitch_connections_login_idx ON public.twitch_connections USING btree (lower(twitch_login))

name: twitch_connections_one_primary_uidx
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX twitch_connections_one_primary_uidx ON public.twitch_connections USING btree (user_id) WHERE (is_primary AND confirmed)

name: twitch_connections_pkey
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX twitch_connections_pkey ON public.twitch_connections USING btree (id)

name: twitch_connections_twitch_user_uidx
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX twitch_connections_twitch_user_uidx ON public.twitch_connections USING btree (twitch_user_id)

name: twitch_connections_user_idx
definition: CREATE INDEX twitch_connections_user_idx ON public.twitch_connections USING btree (user_id)

name: trainers read own twitch connections
definition: roles={authenticated} cmd=SELECT qual=(user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) check=

name: on_auth_identity_created
definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_identity_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.identities FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.handle_new_identity()
